title: Fix MiniMax H3 denoise mask velocity conversion
body:
## Summary

- Scale MiniMax H3 video and audio velocities by their denoise masks before the outer x0 conversion.
- Preserve the existing audio carry/schedule conversion order.
- Add regression coverage for masked video x0 recovery and masked audio carry conversion.

The model evaluates masked rows at the local timestep `mask * sigma`, while the outer `CONST` conversion uses the global sigma. Applying the mask to the returned velocity restores the equivalent x0 conversion:

`x - sigma * (mask * velocity)`

Fixes #15981
Likely fixes #15978

## Testing

- `python -m pytest -q tests-unit/comfy_test/test_minimax_h3_model.py`
  - Baseline `8a33128f2`: 2 failed
  - Patched branch: 2 passed
- `ruff check comfy/ldm/minimax/model.py tests-unit/comfy_test/test_minimax_h3_model.py`
- RTX 5090 CUDA contract check at `sigma=0.45`, `mask=205/256`
  - Baseline maximum x0 error: `0.6487081`
  - Patched maximum x0 error: `4.77e-7`

I actually added this to my current comfyui build and it solved degradation I was getting with long form video chaining, amazing man

While this would not fix whatever is going on in #15978, it seems like a real mild effect because of this bug that affects masks with values between 0 and 1 (binary masks with values at 0 or 1 seem unaffected).

Looking into it this actually also impacts LTX in the same way. It might be a good idea to move this fix up to a shared sampler method.
